```{python}

import pandas as pd
from great_tables import GT
from resume_functions.resume_functions import create_star_rating
```

::: {.columns}
::: {.column .side-column width="35%"}

{{< include content/es/header.md >}}

```{python}
#| echo: false

df_skills = pd.read_csv("./data/es/skills.csv")
df_skills["stars"] = df_skills["mark"].apply(create_star_rating)

GT(
    df_skills[["skill_type", "skill", "description", "stars"]],
    rowname_col="skill",
    groupname_col="skill_type",
).tab_header("Habilidades").cols_label(
    skill="",
    description="",
    stars=""
).cols_width(
    cases={
        "skill": "10%",
        "description": "50%",
        "stars": "20%"
    }
)
```

```{python}
#| echo: false

df_languages = pd.read_csv("./data/es/languages.csv")
df_languages["stars"] = df_languages["mark"].apply(create_star_rating)

GT(
    df_languages[["Language", "Level", "stars"]]
).tab_header("Idiomas").cols_label(
    Language="",
    Level="",
    stars=""
).cols_width(
    cases={
        "Language": "20%",
        "Level": "20%",
        "stars": "10%"
    }
)
```
